suggestibility.description: Local edit-moment hooks must block foreign-locked edits before the cut; cloud sync is out of scope for this dial.

sitrep.description: Agents end every turn with the SITREP table (ideas / roadmap claims / assigned work; code rows must link a roadmap item at creation). Injected per turn by pd-hook-prompt and at session start by the Pilot hook; scaffold via pd sitrep --template.
